evidenceLayout: tmp/examples/EX-NN/ holds each plan's full command logs, one file per command as named in that plan's Verification section, each ending with its exit status. Retries use per-attempt subdirectories tmp/examples/EX-NN/attempt-<n>/. The Playwright scenario writes tmp/examples-e2e/ and the style gate writes tmp/ui-style/. tmp/ is gitignored (**/tmp) and stays untracked. A missing or truncated log is not a pass.

executionModel.commitOwner: The workflow integration step commits and non-force pushes to origin wf/examples with the AGENTS.md 1-6 section message and no tool attribution. Workers never commit, stash, checkout, reset, branch, push or merge. No main push and no PRs.
executionModel.editProtocol: Before each edit, re-read the file and record shasum -a 256 in the plan's Progress Log; record it again after the edit. On drift, stop, record, re-read and re-apply only the plan's own change. Never edit outside writePaths; edit sharedPaths only as their sharedPathNotes describe. EX-00 types are the contract: a dependent plan that needs a contract change records the request in its Progress Log for serial reconciliation instead of editing editor/src/documents/types.ts.
executionModel.heavySuitePolicy: Wave-1 plans run focused vitest files and npm run check only, except EX-10's wasm evaluation test. Full vitest (EX-60, EX-70), the wasm evaluation test (EX-10), npm run test:style and npm run e2e:examples (EX-70) run under the /Users/taco/gits/tacogips/vactr-worktrees/.measure-lock directory lock (mkdir loop, owner file, trap removes only the lock this command created) because sibling runs wf/vim-mode and wf/code-render are active. Never kill processes this run did not start. Tests are silent (silent sink, offline wasm paths) and the system volume is never changed.
executionModel.serialReconciliation: Shared files are each edited by exactly one plan as noted in sharedPathNotes: editor/vite.config.ts (EX-10), editor/src-tauri/src/lib.rs and editor/src-tauri/Cargo.lock (EX-30), editor/src/app/main.ts and editor/test/app/main.test.ts (EX-60), editor/package.json, editor/test/style/ui-style.mjs and README.md (EX-70). npm run check errors confined to another wave-1 plan's files are recorded and re-checked after that plan lands; EX-60 runs the whole-project check. No broad formatting, lockfile refresh or impl-plans/README.md edit inside the plans.
executionModel.buildPrerequisite: The release wasm is absent in this worktree. Every command that needs editor/dist uses VACTR_WASM=../target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/debug/vactr.wasm npm run build. The debug wasm cdylib and tree-sitter-vact.wasm are prebuilt; npm ci is done.

designDecisionsAndRationale: New examples/showcase.vact is the built-in default because no existing example has a visual chain and the issue asks for a visually and sonically busy first impression; gain bounds keep the level moderate.
Registered means evaluates without error in the wasm browser tier, proven by editor/test/wasm/examples.test.ts; requirement badges (audio-input, midi) mark openable entries with extra needs.
Lazy per-example glob chunks keep the main bundle from growing with the example count; only catalog.json is eager.
Replacement is one isolateHistory transaction so Mod-Z restores the previous text; dirty buffers get an inline confirmation row (no window.confirm).
Draft holds unsaved edits only; clean loads and saves clear it, so a reload after opening an unchanged example falls through to the template or showcase.
Storage reads never delete foreign or corrupt values; a future schema uses a new key prefix.

App default template uses a narrow Rust command writing a fixed file in app_config_dir because webview localStorage differs between dev and release origins, can be cleared with website data, and cannot be tested in-repo, while cargo test proves persistence against a real file; app commands are not ACL-gated (plain tauri_build::build()), so capabilities stay unchanged.
Default template snapshots are frozen copies because the dialog-only fs scope cannot reopen a stored path at the next launch.
Web also offers the default-template choice (XQ1 recommendation A).
intentionalTradeoffs: On the web a draft shadows the chosen default template at startup (precedence 2 before 3); New applies the template.
The app has no draft autosave or browser library; it uses file dialogs (XQ2).
Documents larger than 262144 UTF-16 code units are not stored in the browser; the status points to file Save.
Native-only and sample-dependent examples are hidden everywhere (XQ3).
No startup form for an explicit file exists; Open file is an in-session picker action.
supportedEdgeCases: ?example= with an existing web draft: the draft is loaded first without an undo step, then the example replaces it as one undoable step; Mod-Z recovers the draft and autosave rewrites it.
Unknown ?example= id, unregistered template example id or rejected chunk load: status notice and fall-through to the next source; all failing leaves an empty buffer with a notice.
localStorage null, throwing SecurityError on access, QuotaExceededError (including legacy codes 22/1014), corrupt JSON, wrong v, invalid shapes: the editor still opens with the startup document.
User edits during startup are never overwritten (loadInitial skips a changed buffer).
Name rules: trimmed 1-80 chars, no control characters, unique; renaming to its own name is allowed; rename/delete of the current library entry updates the session source.
FileCancelled from Open file is silent; confirmation happens before the file dialog.
Tauri template file missing, unparsable, wrong version or invalid: get returns null and leaves the file in place; invalid set input leaves the file unchanged.
outOfScopeEdgeCases: Schema migration from a future vactr.doc.v2 prefix.
Cross-tab synchronization of drafts or the library.
Native-tier evaluation of examples for the app.
Stored file paths reopened across app launches.
